summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders to be held virtually on October 8, 2026. The record date is August 13, 2026, and the proxy statement will be sent on or around August 14, 2026. This is a routine AGM notice. No terms, premium, advisors, or structural details are present. There is no special situation; this is merely a scheduling announcement.
